subtitle: How Chandela Engineers Turned Dry Stone into Living Water

panels.shot: sweeping aerial wide over a vast stone embankment tank shimmering beside rocky hills and the clustered town of Mahoba
panels.action: Madanavarman stands on the crest of a grand earthen-stone bund, cloak whipping in a dry wind, looking out over a broad, gleaming tank that mirrors the temples and rocky Bundelkhand hills beyond.

dialogue.text: In a land with no great river, Madanavarman of Mahoba wagered his kingdom on lakes he carved from rock and rain.

i18n.hi: जहाँ कोई बड़ी नदी नहीं, वहाँ महोबा के मदनवर्मन ने पहाड़ और बरसात चीर कर झीलों पर अपना राज दांव पर लगाया।

panels.shot: wide establishing shot across parched Bundelkhand plateau
panels.action: The rocky plateau of Bundelkhand stretches under a harsh sun, scrub and thin fields clinging to shallow soil, a narrow seasonal stream already shrinking between stony banks.

dialogue.text: Bundelkhand was stone and sky. Rains came in a rush, then left months of thirst. No Ganga, no Narmada guarded Mahoba.

i18n.hi: बुंदेलखंड बस पत्थर और आसमान। बरसात झटके में आती, महीनों की प्यास छोड़ जाती। न गंगा, न नर्मदा महोबा की रखवाली पर।

panels.shot: slow push-in on a faint outline of old tank embankments in present-day landscape
panels.action: Modern villagers and cattle walk along worn grassy ridges, the ancient curves of tank bunds faintly visible, with broken laterite blocks half-buried along their slopes.

dialogue.text: Yet the land still holds their work. Old bunds, half-ruined, frame dried basins named Madan Sagar, Kirat Sagar and Kalyan Sagar.

i18n.hi: फिर भी ज़मीन पर उनका काम टिका है। पुराने, टूटे बाँध सूखे तालों को घेरते हैं—मदन सागर, किरत सागर, कल्याण सागर।

panels.shot: medium shot of Madanavarman in court, map spread
panels.action: Inside a Chandela hall at Mahoba, Madanavarman leans over a palm-leaf plan etched with hills and streams, courtiers and scribes around him, a low relief of a tank and temple carved on the wall behind.

dialogue.text: When Madanavarman took the throne around 1128, his strength lay not in a river valley but in a rocky capital that had to drink from its own hands.

i18n.hi: लगभग 1128 में जब मदनवर्मन गादी पर बैठे, उनका बल किसी नदी घाटी में नहीं, बल्कि ऐसे पथरीले राजधानी में था जिसे अपना पानी खुद बनाना था।

panels.shot: close-up on Madanavarman’s face, eyes intent
panels.action: Madanavarman’s face fills the frame, calm yet alert, a thin tilak on his forehead, light from a courtyard glinting off his eyes as he listens intently to an unseen advisor.

dialogue.speaker: madanavarman
dialogue.text: Land we can guard with steel. But how do we guard the rain?

i18n.hi: ज़मीन तलवार से बचा लेंगे, पर बरसात कैसे बचाएँ?

panels.shot: bird’s-eye view of Mahoba with marked seasonal streams
panels.action: A bird’s-eye view of Mahoba’s surroundings shows small hills, seasonal streams glinting in the monsoon, and faint lines drawn where embankments could rise; Madanavarman gestures across the landscape from a pavilion balcony.

dialogue.text: His ministers spoke of campaigns and tribute. Inscriptions would later praise his reach, from Augasi to Mau. But his gaze kept returning to the sky and the dry beds below.

i18n.hi: मंत्री युद्धों और लगान की बातें करते। बाद की शिलालेखें उनकी चौहद्दी—औगासी से मऊ—का बखान करेंगी। पर उनकी नज़र बार‑बार आसमान और सूखे तलों पर लौट आती।

panels.shot: wide shot of engineers and workers marking bund line with pegs
panels.action: Royal artisans and overseers in simple cotton mark a gentle valley with wooden stakes and cords, while in the background Madanavarman watches from horseback, a rocky stream trickling behind him.

dialogue.text: Chandela builders had long known the art. They caught seasonal flows behind earthen and stone bunds, spreading water into tanks that fed fields, beasts and shrines.

i18n.hi: चंदेला कारीगरों को यह खेल पुराना था। वे मौसमी धार पकड़कर मिट्टी‑पत्थर के बाँधों के पीछे रोके, और तालाबों में फैलाते जो खेत, जानवर और मंदिरों को सींचते।

panels.shot: low-angle shot of workers placing large stone blocks in embankment
panels.action: Bare-chested labourers and masons haul and set laterite blocks into a rising embankment, their bodies straining, dust hanging in the air as ox-carts bring more stone to the site.

dialogue.text: At Mahoba they built on that craft. Tank by tank, bund by bund, they turned short-lived streams into wide sheets of stored rain.

i18n.hi: महोबा में उसी हुनर को आगे बढ़ाया। तालाब पर तालाब, बाँध पर बाँध, उन्होंने छिनभर की धारियों को फैले हुए जमा पानी की चादरों में बदला।

panels.shot: medium shot of a stone-lined spillway channel
panels.action: An engineer points to a carefully sloped stone-lined channel cut into the embankment, where a controlled spillway drops towards a secondary basin below.

dialogue.text: These were not ponds by chance. They had planned inlets and outlets, stone spillways to tame sudden floods, and linked basins to pass excess safely downstream.

i18n.hi: ये यूँ ही बने पोखर नहीं थे। सोच‑समझकर घाट‑निकास, पत्थर की पटरी से बाढ़ काबू, और जुड़े ताल, जो अतिरिक्त पानी को सुरक्षित नीचे ले जाएँ।

panels.shot: wide shot of tank during first filling monsoon
panels.action: Dark monsoon clouds break open as rain pelts the new embankment; muddy water gushes through channels, spreading into a wide, rising lake where dry ground stood weeks before.

dialogue.text: Then came the test. First monsoon, first flood. The bunds held. Dry hollows became Madan Sagar, Kirat Sagar, Kalyan Sagar—new seas under a Bundelkhand sky.

i18n.hi: फिर परीक्षा आई—पहला सावन, पहली बाढ़। बाँध टिके रहे। सूखे गड्ढे बने मदन सागर, किरत सागर, कल्याण सागर—बुंदेलखंड के आसमान के नीचे नई समंदर।

panels.shot: gentle wide shot of daily life around tank edges
panels.action: Women fill pots at the water’s edge, cattle drink further down, fishermen push a small boat, and a line of trees shades a simple shrine on the tank’s ghats.

dialogue.text: Around their banks, life thickened. Wells lasted longer, fields greened in the dry months, fish and lotus filled the basins, and animals found shade and water close to the town.

i18n.hi: उनके किनारों पर ज़िंदगी गाढ़ी हो गई। कुएँ देर तक भरे रहे, सूखे महीनों में खेत हरे, तालों में मछली और कमल, और जानवरों को शहर के पास ही छाँव‑पानी मिला।

panels.shot: medium shot of priests and pilgrims at ghat steps
panels.action: Priests guide pilgrims down broad stone steps into the tank, where some bathe, others offer flowers, and a small temple pavilion stands just above the waterline.

dialogue.text: Water and worship met. Ghats grew along the shores. Ritual bathing, daily ablutions and temple offerings tied the tanks into the sacred rhythm of the capital.

i18n.hi: पानी और पूजा एक हो गए। घाट उभरे किनारों पर। स्नान, नित्य नहाना, मंदिरों की आहुतियाँ—सबने तालाबों को राजधानी की धर्म‑धड़कन से बाँध दिया।

panels.shot: wide shot of Khajuraho temple complex with visible tank in foreground
panels.action: A grand Khajuraho temple rises beyond a tank, its shikhara etched against clear sky, while a tree-lined embankment and a cluster of smaller ponds shimmer in the foreground.

dialogue.text: At Khajuraho too, tanks ringed the shrines. Tradition remembers sixty-four water bodies; surveys still trace dozens, stitching pilgrimage to a careful web of stored rain.

i18n.hi: खजुराहो में भी मंदिरों को तालाबों ने घेरा। परंपरा चौसठ जलाशयों की बात करती है; सर्वे आज भी दर्जनों के निशान पकड़ते हैं, तीर्थ को सहेजे हुए बारिश के जाल से सिलते।

panels.shot: close-up of an inscription being carved on stone
panels.action: A court scribe chisels fine Nagari letters into a stone slab, the unfinished Augasi inscription visible with its elegant lines, a lamp and palm-leaf manuscript nearby.

dialogue.text: Inscriptions from Augasi and Mau speak of Madanavarman’s reach and order. They praise his conquests and generosity, while the silent tanks show another side of his rule.

i18n.hi: औगासी और मऊ के शिलालेख मदनवर्मन की पहुँच और अनुशासन का ज़िक्र करते हैं। वे उनकी विजय और दान गाते हैं, और खामोश टैंक उनके राज का दूसरा चेहरा दिखाते हैं।

panels.shot: medium shot of Madanavarman meeting a village headman near a tank
panels.action: Madanavarman stands with a village headman and a tax official at the edge of a tank, farmers and irrigated plots visible behind them as they gesture over the landscape.

dialogue.text: Tax, protection, water—each fed the other. Tanks made crops steadier; crops fed the treasury; the treasury paid soldiers and builders to keep the bunds and borders strong.

i18n.hi: कर, सुरक्षा, पानी—तीनों ने एक‑दूसरे को थामा। टैंकों ने फसलें टिकाई, फसलों ने ख़ज़ाना, और ख़ज़ाने ने सिपाही‑मज़दूर जो बाँध और सरहद मजबूत रखें।

panels.shot: wide shot of drought year landscape with tanks still holding some water
panels.action: Under a glaring sun, fields at a distance look pale and cracked, yet the large tanks near Mahoba still hold deep, shaded water, where people and animals gather tightly.

dialogue.text: In lean years, the difference showed. When streams failed and smaller wells ran dry, the big tanks kept Mahoba drinking, bathing, and sowing at least a second chance.

i18n.hi: कठिन बरसों में फर्क साफ दिखा। जब धाराएँ थम गईं और छोटे कुएँ सूख गए, बड़े टैंकों ने महोबा को पीने, नहाने और दोबारा बोने का मौका दिया।

panels.shot: time-lapse style wide shot montage suggestion of centuries passing over the tanks
panels.action: The same tank is shown through subtle changes: Chandela banners give way to later forts, ghats crumble, new houses rise, yet the broad water body remains in the hollow.

dialogue.text: Dynasties shifted, raids came and went. The Chandela temples at Khajuraho weathered time. So did the basins that held their rain, even as names and patrons changed.

i18n.hi: वंश बदले, लुटेरे आते‑जाते रहे। खजुराहो के चंदेला मंदिर वक़्त झेल गए। जैसे वे ताल, जो उनकी बरसात सँभाले रहे, चाहे नाम और मालिक बदलते रहे।

panels.shot: intimate medium close-up of Madanavarman at twilight on tank embankment
panels.action: At twilight, Madanavarman stands alone on the bund, looking at the tank surface turning bronze with the setting sun, his posture reflective, hands resting lightly on the stone parapet.

dialogue.speaker: madanavarman
dialogue.text: Battles pass in a season. A full tank can outlast a king.

i18n.hi: युद्ध एक मौसम में बीत जाते हैं, भरा टैंक राजा से लंबा जीता है।

panels.shot: wide contemplative shot of present-day Mahoba tank with children playing
panels.action: In the present day, children play along the shore of an old Mahoba tank, fishermen mend nets, and concrete houses line the ancient embankment that still curves around the water.

dialogue.text: Madanavarman’s age is gone, but the tanks of Mahoba and Khajuraho remain, quiet proofs that a kingdom’s might once lay in the patience to store tomorrow’s rain.

i18n.hi: मदनवर्मन का ज़माना गया, पर महोबा और खजुराहो के ये टैंक अब भी खड़े हैं—खामोश सबूत कि कभी एक राज्य की ताकत कल की बारिश बचा रखने के सब्र में थी।

title_i18n.en: The Tanks That Kept Mahoba Alive
title_i18n.hi: महोबा को ज़िंदा रखने वाले टैंक

subtitle_i18n.en: How Chandela Engineers Turned Dry Stone into Living Water
subtitle_i18n.hi: कैसे चंदेला इंजीनियरों ने सूखी चट्टान से बहता पानी जगा दिया
